name: soc-investigation-workbench
description: Plan and review evidence-backed SOC investigations with canonical Sentinel hunt reuse.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and review multi-step SOC investigations.
interface.longDescription: Maintain scoped evidence, competing hypotheses, and bounded next steps. Delegate hunt workflows to a pinned Sentinel package.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan the next useful steps for this scoped security investigation and identify conflicting evidence and telemetry gaps.
